description: TGIIC identified 200 acres of land along Outer Ring Road in Maheshwaram, Serilingampally, Chevella and Ibrahimpatnam mandals for setting up the city | India News
body_lead: Telangana announces plan to build AI city in Hyderabad TGIIC identified 200 acres of land along Outer Ring Road in Maheshwaram, Serilingampally, Chevella and Ibrahimpatnam mandals for setting up the city The Telangana government has drawn up a plan to establish India’s first and largest Artificial Intelligence (AI) city on the outskirts of Hyderabad to house and promote AI ecosystem and to invite top companies to set up their AI centres. “Hyderabad has been known as a top information technology (IT) hub in the country.
